title: Selective Knowledge Control for Continual GUI Agent Learning over Application Streams
abstract: arXiv:2609.06530v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual learning is a crucial capability for Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents to adapt to evolving applications while retaining knowledge acquired from previous applications. Such application streams pose a challenging knowledge modeling problem: new applications often share underlying knowledge with past ones, yet also introduce specific knowledge that must not interfere with historical knowledge. In this paper, we propose activation-conditioned selective knowledge control, a lightweight method that achieves selective knowledge retention via neuron-level gradient manipulation. Our method maintains a compact historical knowledge state to protect highly activated MLP neurons that preserve previous knowledge. When a new application arrives, it performs real-time gradient surgery conditioned on forward activation. translated_title: 面向应用流上GUI智能体持续学习的选择性知识控制
translated_abstract: 持续学习是图形用户界面（GUI）智能体的一项关键能力，使其能够在适应不断演化的应用程序的同时，保留从先前应用中习得的知识。这类应用流提出了一个具有挑战性的知识建模问题：新应用往往与过去的应用共享底层知识，但同时也会引入不应干扰历史知识的特定知识。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于激活条件的选择性知识控制方法，这是一种通过神经元级梯度操作实现选择性知识保留的轻量级方法。我们的方法维护一个紧凑的历史知识状态，以保护那些保存先前知识的高度激活的MLP神经元。当新应用到来时，该方法基于前向激活执行实时梯度手术。具体而言，受保护的神经元被分为两种类型：持有特定知识的未激活神经元，其……
tldr: 提出了一种基于激活条件的选择性知识控制方法，通过神经元级的梯度操作保护历史知识，使GUI智能体能够在应用流上持续学习新应用的同时避免灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: Proposes an activation-conditioned selective knowledge control method that uses neuron-level gradient manipulation to protect historical knowledge, enabling GUI agents to continually learn from application streams without catastrophic forgetting.
